build_riemannian_ode_solver: build a RiemannianODESolver with a manifold and velocity model to solve ODEs on manifolds
run_sample_euler: run the RiemannianODESolver sample method using the euler integration method with a given step size
run_sample_rk4: run the RiemannianODESolver sample method using the rk4 integration method to integrate on a manifold
run_euler_step: run an euler step on a manifold using a velocity model and projection options
run_rk4_step: run an RK4 step on a manifold using a velocity model with tangent plane projection
